Any translation-invariant (difference-set) countermodel attempt over Z collapses: an additive sub-semigroup of Z containing 0 that is unbounded both above and below is forced (Bezout + scaling) to equal g*Z for some g, i.e. a subgroup, hence symmetric -- so no countermodel exists in this natural infinite family.

The Zorn/chain-union pattern (reused from PrimeLemma.lean's Lindenbaum construction) does not transfer to this problem: hfour/hsymbox take their raised point as a hypothesis, not an axiom-supplied existential, so there is no natural set-of-pairs poset whose maximal element pins two ALREADY-FIXED points exactly.

When a bounded decisive probe hits neither GATE-A (proof) nor GATE-B (countermodel), the sanctioned response is a documented [BLOCKED] handoff plus a follow-up-task recommendation for the next-largest strategy -- never a strategic sorry and never an undirected repeat dispatch at the same wall.
